## Renewal status

Globex renews **2026-09-30** and is on track. Risk level: **low**. Open items: updated DPA (legal) and multi-year discount quote (procurement).

Sources: [Globex — Renewal Status (Q3 2026)](https://portal.acme.internal/sales/accounts/globex/renewal-q3-2026)

## Account brief — Globex

**Overview:** Largest Acme account; ARR $840,000; 1,200 seats; owner Sam Reyes.

**Renewal:** 2026-09-30, on track, low risk.

**Security:** June 2026 questionnaire accepted with no follow-ups.

Sources:
- [Globex — Account Notes](https://portal.acme.internal/sales/accounts/globex)
- [Globex — Renewal Status (Q3 2026)](https://portal.acme.internal/sales/accounts/globex/renewal-q3-2026)

## Renewal risks — Globex

Overall risk is **low** (no competitive evaluation). Watch: DPA finalization and multi-year discount quote.

Source: [Globex — Renewal Status (Q3 2026)](https://portal.acme.internal/sales/accounts/globex/renewal-q3-2026)

## Account brief — Globex

Globex is Acme's largest account (ARR $840,000), owned by Sam Reyes, renewing 2026-09-30 at low risk.
